sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: An evergreen tropical tree, usually around 15 m tall but reaching about 26 m. Its deeply lobed leaves can be up to 30 cm long. Male and female inflorescences are separate; the female flowers fuse into a large compound fruit that can reach about 30 cm. A cultigen originating in the north-west Pacific, breadfruit is now cultivated throughout the tropics.

sections.title: Food
sections.text: The starchy fruit is usually eaten cooked. Seeded forms also occur and their seeds are eaten. Seedlessness or the presence of seeds alone does not indicate a different species.
